message: Thanks, that sets the scene. What did you do yourself?

parts.text: I was the backend lead at Acme when we were moving checkout to a new payments provider, and the rollout was two weeks late.
quotes: Last year at Acme I was the backend lead
we were moving checkout to the new payments provider
the rollout was already two weeks late

parts.text: Black Friday was a month out, and checkout could not break.
quotes: Black Friday was a month out and checkout could not break
